resource.title: Dive into Systems (Suzanne J. Matthews, Tia Newhall, Kevin C. Webb；免费在线教材)
resource.covers: 第 5 章讲指令集/处理器执行与流水线；第 7-9 章分别用 64 位 x86、32 位 x86、ARMv8 (AArch64) 讲汇编基础、常用指令、条件与循环、函数调用（栈帧 sp/x29、参数传递）、递归、数组/结构体与缓冲区溢出；第 10 章汇总几种汇编的异同，可对照 CISC/RISC 思路。

courses.course: EECS 373 Introduction to Embedded System Design
courses.prereq_text: Prerequisites: EECS 270; EECS 370 ... To be successful in EECS 373 students should be familiar with: ... (on the computer architecture side) assembly language, pipelining, memory, and caching

courses.course: CS 61C Great Ideas of Computer Architecture (Machine Structures)
courses.prereq_text: Prerequisites: 61A, along with either 61B or 61BL, or programming experience equivalent to that gained in 9C, 9F, or 9G.

extra_prereqs.evidence: University of Michigan EECS 373 先修含 EECS 270（数字逻辑），并要求熟悉布尔代数、门电路、触发器与状态机
EECS 373 overview: 'To be successful ... should be familiar with ... pipelining, memory, and caching'
UC Berkeley CS 61C 要求 61A（其汇编/ABI 部分即本节点入门内容）
UC Berkeley CS 61C 要求 61B/61BL（数据结构）

notes: Dive into Systems 的 ARMv8 一章目录与 9.5 Functions in Assembly 正文均已打开核实（https://diveintosystems.org/book/C9-ARM64/functions.html 有 sp/x29 栈帧、函数调用管理的内容）。该教材不专门讲 AArch64 异常级 EL0-EL3，异常/中断部分需另配 Arm 官方架构文档；EECS 373 的 overview 页未在正文里点名 ARM 型号，故只把它当作“嵌入式/汇编课要求机器结构先修”的证据。
